in_sanskrit.name: शशिधर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: शशि (shashi) means 'truth' or 'reality'. धर (dhar) means 'to hold'. So, शशिधर (shashidhar) means 'one who holds the truth' or 'one who upholds the truth'.

in_hindi.name: शशिधर
in_hindi.long_meaning: शशि (shashi) means 'truth' or 'reality'. धर (dhar) means 'to hold'. So, शशिधर (shashidhar) means 'one who holds the truth' or 'one who upholds the truth'.

in_tamil.name: சஶிதர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: சஶி (cshashi) means 'truth' or 'reality'. ஆர் (ar) means 'one who'. லர் (lar) means 'holds'. So, சஶிதர் (cshashidhar) means 'one who holds the truth' or 'one who upholds the truth'.

in_telugu.name: శశిధర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: శశి (shashi) means 'truth' or 'reality'. ధర్ (dhar) means 'to hold'. So, శశిధర్ (shashidhar) means 'one who holds the truth' or 'one who upholds the truth'.

in_marathi.name: Shashidhar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shashidhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lord Shashi is the god of knowledge and wisdom. He is the god who imparts knowledge to students and scholars. He is also known as the god of learning, wisdom and intellect.

in_bengali.name: Shashidhar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Knowledge
in_bengali.long_meaning: Shashidhar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Lord Shashi is the god of knowledge and wisdom. He is the god who imparts knowledge to students and scholars. He is also known as the god of learning, wisdom and intellect.
